Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Take, for example, Pulled Fangs.
In order to remove this card, it takes two actions.
Do these actions have to be done in the same turn, or
should you keep track if you've half-removed it? (Does
the first of these two actions "fade" after a certain
amount of time?)

Does it count against the NRA rule, if a minion tries
to do both of those actions himself in the same turn (with
freak drive or whatever)?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
>
> Take, for example, Pulled Fangs.
> In order to remove this card, it takes two actions.
> Do these actions have to be done in the same turn, or
> should you keep track if you've half-removed it? (Does
> the first of these two actions "fade" after a certain
> amount of time?)

The two actions need not be taken in the same turn, since no
such restriction is made by card text.

You should keep track if you've half-removed it.

There is no provision for the "fading" of an action given
in card text.

> Does it count against the NRA rule, if a minion tries
> to do both of those actions himself in the same turn (with
> freak drive or whatever)?

Yes. See the NRA rule.
